frontend_api.evidence: PPMLConfig appends relu_stall_rounds (int>=0, default 20) and relu_strict (bool, default False), validated in validate(); IVPPMLConfig inherits both. Keyword use unchanged; IVPPMLConfig own max_step_halving/step_halving_memory move two positions later. Unused hdfe_tol argument removed from internal relu_separation.
frontend_api.description: Public call signatures, exports, aliases, CLI/front-end validation and compatibility.

backend_compute.evidence: Uncertified ReLU re-runs the same loop on rows still positive in the last iterate with other rows fixed at z=0; only rows certified by the restricted problem are dropped. Stall exit after relu_stall_rounds rounds without support change. No solver default, cache or resource-control change.
backend_compute.description: Solver/compute/cache/backend contracts, numerical defaults and resource controls.

errors.evidence: Uncertified ReLU emits existing SeparationWarning, or raises existing ConvergenceError with new code convergence.separation_relu (stage separation, details status/iterations/candidates/verified) under relu_strict=True or unified mode. No new exception class.
errors.description: Structured exception classes, codes, stages, suggestions and public error boundaries.
